verification.precondition: The production Survey runtime and session store share the exact candidate identity and an initialized zero-journal root.
verification.stimulus: Commit the atomic AT01 plus T02 initialization, read session.json through the authenticated boundary, and independently validate its neutral replay.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The one-record journal authenticates to its final record digest, closes to its terminal revision, and reproduces the persisted workspace and machine heads.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: an authenticated filesystem read replays the exact committed Survey journal
verification.forbiddenMutation: Read validation must not skip schema, root-seal, Survey-semantic, identity, or journal closure checks and must not synthesize a different terminal state.

behavior: an authenticated filesystem read replays the exact committed Survey journal
